sanitized_scheduler_capacity_readback.interpretation: At this readback, the only non-AISG_debug H200 node whose unassigned resource counters could fit the complete request was offline. No non-offline node simultaneously exposed one H200 GPU, 12 CPUs and 128 GiB. This supports a site-capacity wait, not a malformed project, queue, memory or GPU request. Node names and other-user job identities are intentionally omitted.

B0_actual_condition_cost.interpretation: At the observed maximum cost, one 8-hour allocation is not sufficient for all 39 remaining conditions. This is a conservative runway signal, not an assertion that every remaining condition will take the maximum. Valid partial results must be preserved and settled at the native wall boundary; unrun conditions are not scientific failures.

exact_remaining_route_readback.interpretation: The exact frozen implementation, executed read-only against the current sealed Hopper child, produces 39 attempts. It skips all nine valid prior outcomes and emits only the one evidence-qualified replacement for the diagnosed engineering interruption.

training_actual_update_cost.interpretation: Each A_CONTROL or B_COVERAGE endpoint is provisionally compatible with one 8-hour job when using the slower of two published actual update rates plus 25 percent planning headroom. Cold qualification, full-state checkpoint IO and any future native measurement remain outside the measured update wall and must be admitted after B0.

bank_reuse_readback.required_on_allocation: Rehash all bank members and rerun the official processor/collator consumption proof before model use. Reuse does not waive data identity or model-plus-optimizer peak-memory proof.
